stem: Which sentence from the selection best explains why the black-backed woodpecker is able to build its unique type of home?

options.label: A
options.text: This woodpecker relies on the environment of the burned forest. (paragraph 2)

options.label: B
options.text: This nest is usually built inside a tree trunk or a fallen log. (paragraph 4)

options.label: C
options.text: It also has a very thick skull bone and a strong neck. (paragraph 4)

options.label: D
options.text: The woodpecker can move into the nest cavity as soon as it is drilled. (paragraph 4)
